node.title: E1 named-field folded cell certificate soundness
node.statement: For N' in {128,256}, a named prime field with a primitive N'th root plus a complete folded no-vector certificate returning zero nonzero non-cyclotomic folded vectors implies the corresponding E1 folded certificate cell payload.
node.attack_surface: schema dispatch from named field/root and complete zero no-vector certificate to an E1 folded cell payload
node.falsifier: a named field/root and complete zero no-vector certificate while the corresponding E1 folded cell payload fails
